chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever leads a people in salat (prayer) and singles himself out in supplication instead of them has betrayed them."

key_terms.بِالدُّعَاءِ: with supplication, invoking Allah in prayer
key_terms.بِقَوْمٍ: with a group of people, meaning a congregation
key_terms.خَانَهُمْ: he has betrayed them or failed in his trust toward them
key_terms.صَلَّى: performed salat (prayer), here in the sense of leading the congregation

ai.seo_question: What does Islam teach about an Imam making du'a only for himself in congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the one who leads others in congregational salat (prayer) should include them in his du'a (supplication) and not reserve it only for himself. It emphasizes communal care, trust, and sincerity in worship, showing that the Imam of prayer bears a moral responsibility toward those praying behind him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1187 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever leads a group in prayer and reserves the supplication for himself, excluding them, has betrayed them”.
